about.title: About Kalyan Design Studio
about.overview: With our projects spanning over the spheres of residential, commercial and corporate construction, we, at Kalyan Studio, aim to deliver excellence and timeless aesthetics. Our skillful interdisciplinary team works closely with our clients and engages in a diverse array of design styles from contemporary, modern, and classical to Scandinavian or baroque — truly a one-of-its-kind service.
about.residentialFocus: Our full service, residential offering covers every detail of your house's interior designs. From space planning to furnishings, and everything between. At Interiors by Kalyan Design Studio, we aspire to create cohesive and beautiful environments that are as individual as the clients themselves.
about.philosophy: Our home interior design services are comprehensive and include everything — from space planning to custom furniture design, lighting design, material selection, and complete turnkey execution.

process.title: BRIEFING
process.description: We begin with an exhaustive questionnaire to fully grasp the vision, needs and expectations of the Client. Getting the brief right is key to success of the project.

process.title: DESIGN
process.description: Translating the brief into the design blueprint is the next step. We start with a 2-D floor plan followed by 3-D visualisation of the space. This helps paint a vivid picture of the eventual look and feel of the interiors for the client.

process.title: EXECUTION
process.description: This is where the design comes to life. We undertake only end-end projects and aim for perfection in every inch. Along with our handpicked team of craftsmen and vendors from across the world, we deliver a globally-inspired functional work of art.

process.title: HANDOVER
process.description: This marks the culmination of an exciting journey for both the client and us as we handover the keys to their new home. A space all set to delight the occupants for years to come.

services.title: MODULAR KITCHEN
services.subtitle: Heart of the Home & Culinary Luxury
services.summary: Customized modular kitchens tailored for modern lifestyle, heavy cooking durability, and seamless spatial ergonomics.
services.description: The kitchen is often one of the most used rooms in the house. The kitchen is the heartbeat of all festivity, a core to every family gathering, and the beat of every party. When the kitchen is well designed eating becomes an enjoyable experience. However, selecting the right kitchen design is never easy. It involves more significant purposes other than comfort and aesthetics. Most people start their days in their kitchens. We aimed to make the compact space look spacious by utilizing natural light and open-ended layouts with a finer eye to the details.
features: Modular kitchens can be customized to fit any size or shape space
Wide variety of cabinets, quartz/granite countertops, and built-in appliances
Ergonomic work triangle optimizing refrigerator, sink, and cooking hob
Durable boiling water resistant (BWR) marine grade plywood carcass
Soft-close tandem drawers and corner carousel pull-outs

services.title: 3D INTERIOR MODELS
services.subtitle: Photorealistic Virtual Walkthroughs
services.summary: High-fidelity 3D visualization and simulation empowering clients to experience spaces before execution begins.
services.description: 3D models are a potent tool for interior designers to effectively communicate designs to their clients via three-dimensional visualization, increasing project approval rates. 3D interior design shifts the control to the hands of clients by enabling them to alter or transform designs. We aimed to make the compact space look spacious by utilizing natural light and open-ended layouts with a finer eye to the details. Clients and designers can see a realistic representation of the interior design before construction or renovation begins.
features: Apply realistic textures and materials to surfaces for walls, floors, and fabrics
Physically accurate lighting simulation with daytime and dusk scenes
360-degree virtual walkthrough and panoramic view inspection
Precision dimension checks reducing on-site structural modifications
Interactive material and color palette revisions

services.title: TV CABINET
services.subtitle: Bespoke Media Consoles & Feature Walls
services.summary: Sophisticated entertainment units combining fluted panels, concealed cable management, and ambient backlighting.
services.description: A TV cabinet is a piece of furniture specifically designed to house a television. It typically has a flat top surface on which the TV can be placed, and shelves or compartments below for storing electronics, movies, video games, or other media. TV cabinets can also have features like cable management holes, drawers, and cabinets for additional storage. We aimed to make the compact space look spacious by utilizing natural light and open-ended layouts with a finer eye to the details.
features: Low-profile consoles designed for rooms with fireplaces or low focal points
High-wall storage integration with acoustic fluted panelling and display niches
Corner units engineered to maximize compact living room layouts
Concealed conduits for 100% invisible wiring and device integration
Dimmable warm LED cove profiles behind marble or charcoal louvers

services.title: GYPSUM CEILING
services.subtitle: Architectural Drywall False Ceilings
services.summary: Acoustic absorption, thermal cooling efficiency, and designer cove lighting false ceiling installations.
services.description: A gypsum ceiling, also known as a drywall ceiling or plasterboard ceiling, is a type of ceiling made from gypsum plasterboards. These are prefabricated panels made of gypsum, a naturally occurring mineral consisting of hydrated calcium sulfate. Gypsum ceilings can help to absorb sound, which can improve the acoustics of a room. This is especially beneficial in large, open spaces or rooms with hard surfaces, such as tile or concrete floors. Gypsum ceilings can also help to insulate a room, which can help to reduce heating and cooling costs.
features: Superior acoustic dampening and echo reduction for living rooms & home theaters
Thermal insulation keeping Odisha homes significantly cooler during hot summers
Smooth, seamless surface ready for premium low-VOC paints and textures
Concealed architectural cove profiles for glare-free indirect lighting
Fire-resistant core conforming to modern safety specifications

services.title: PVC CEILING
services.subtitle: Moisture & Termite Proof Ceiling Panels
services.summary: Low-maintenance, waterproof PVC ceiling solutions ideal for balconies, kitchens, and contemporary living areas.
services.description: PVC ceiling panels offer high durability and complete resistance to moisture and insects. Since PVC ceiling panels are made of lightweight engineered polymers, they are exceptionally easy to maintain. Regular wiping with a damp cloth is usually sufficient to keep them looking brand new. They come in a variety of colors, designs, and textures, allowing for flexibility in interior design choices — mimicking the look of teak wood, marble, or metallic finishes.
features: 100% moisture-proof and termite-resistant suitable for humid coastal climates
Available in rich natural wood-grain, charcoal, and metallic textured finishes
Zero painting required — retains fresh luster with simple damp cloth cleaning
Calibrated for energy-efficient recessed LED spot and magnetic track lights
Quick, dust-free installation with interlocking tongue-and-groove joints

services.title: CORE HOUSE PLAN
services.subtitle: Comprehensive Architectural Blueprints
services.summary: Master architectural layouts, 2D floor plans, spatial zoning, and complete exterior elevations.
services.description: Core House Planning outlines the structural layout of the house, including precise room dimensions, the arrangement of rooms (such as bedrooms, living areas, kitchen, bathrooms), and the overall flow of the space. This plan shows the entire property and its context, including the house, driveway, landscaping, and other features. Includes detailed exterior elevations from all sides illustrating architectural details and materials.
features: Vastu-compliant spatial zoning and ventilation alignment
Complete 2D floor plans with exact millimeter dimensions
Exterior front, rear, and lateral 3D elevations
Comprehensive site plan including parking, entry gate, and landscaping
Plumbing, electrical, and MEP coordination drawings

services.title: WARDROBE
services.subtitle: Bespoke Modern Closets & Dressing Suites
services.summary: Handcrafted modular wardrobes, floor-to-ceiling sliding systems, and luxury walk-in dressing rooms.
services.description: The modern wardrobe with its hanging spaces, sliding shelves, and drawers evolved to optimize modern living. Our bespoke wardrobe designs ensure ample space for hanging longer items like coats, dresses, and sarees. Customize the interior layout based on your specific storage needs and the types of clothing and accessories you have, including mirrors, valet trays, and sensor-activated illumination.
features: Floor-to-ceiling sliding and hinged wardrobe configurations
Double-hanging rods, adjustable shelving, and lockable safety lockers
Integrated full-length mirrors and sensor-activated internal strip lighting
Bespoke organizer drawers for watches, jewelry, belts, and ties
Anti-fungal, moisture-sealed internal edge-banded carcass

faqs.question: WHAT EXACTLY DOES AN INTERIOR DESIGNER DO?
faqs.answer: An interior designer specializes in creating functional, aesthetically appealing, and safe interior spaces by strategically selecting materials, colors, furniture, lighting, and finishes. They work closely with clients to understand their preferences and requirements, ensuring the design aligns with both style and functionality while adhering to building codes and regulations.

faqs.question: WHAT IS THE ROLE OF THE INTERIOR DESIGNER?
faqs.answer: The role of an interior designer involves conceptualizing and executing design solutions that enhance the functionality and visual appeal of interior spaces. They collaborate with clients to understand their needs, select appropriate materials, and ensure compliance with safety standards, while balancing aesthetics, practicality, and environmental considerations.

faqs.question: WHAT ARE THE 7 ELEMENTS OF INTERIOR DESIGN?
faqs.answer: The seven key elements of interior design are space, line, form, light, color, texture, and pattern. These elements work together to create harmonious and functional interiors. By balancing these components, interior designers craft visually appealing, comfortable, and practical spaces that align with the client’s needs and preferences.

faqs.question: DOES INTERIOR DESIGN INCLUDES FURNITURE?
faqs.answer: Yes, interior design includes furniture as a critical component. Furniture enhances functionality, defines space, and contributes to the overall aesthetic of a design. Interior designers select and arrange furniture to complement the design concept, ensuring it aligns with spatial planning, ergonomics, and the client’s style preferences.

faqs.question: WHY INTERIOR DESIGN?
faqs.answer: Interior design is essential for creating functional, aesthetically pleasing environments that enhance the quality of life. It optimizes space, improves safety, and fosters comfort, reflecting personal or brand identity. By harmonizing elements like color, texture, and lighting, interior design transforms spaces into cohesive, purposeful environments tailored to users' needs.

blog.title: The Psychology of Colors in Interior Design: Unlocking the Power of Hue
blog.excerpt: Discover how the psychology of colors in interior design can transform your living spaces. Learn to create the perfect mood and atmosphere with strategic color choices.
blog.content:
Did you know we can see about 10 million different colors? This amazing ability is key in color psychology in interior design. Colors do more than just look good – they change how we feel in a space.

Color psychology is all about how colors affect our mood and behavior. When we pick colors for our homes, we're not just picking paint. We're creating a feeling in our living spaces.

Key Takeaways:
- Colors have a significant psychological impact on human perception
- Interior color schemes can influence mood and emotional well-being
- Color psychology is a powerful design tool beyond aesthetic choices
- Different hues trigger specific emotional and behavioral responses
- Thoughtful color selection can transform residential and commercial atmospheres.
